## Six inventions that make AI agents trustworthy.

Writing code is no longer the bottleneck — trust and review are. Cerin provides the proof, memory, and runtime awareness that raw terminal models and bloated editor forks lack.

### Proof-Carrying PRs

Zero AI slop. Every change is packaged with a cryptographically signed execution receipt, test exit codes, and verifiable proof that the code actually ran.

### Cerin Anywhere Bridge

Control and steer your running workstation agent from bed or your commute via cerin.space/app. Zero cloud sandboxes — all your local DBs, Docker, and .env stay on your PC.

### Self-Invalidating Repo Memory

Facts link to exact code SHA-256 digests. When you rewrite a function, outdated memory auto-stales. Records a causal pitfall ledger so teams never repeat mistakes.

### Semantic Behavioral Diffs

Review by behavior rather than 1,500 raw lines. Highlights added/removed API symbols, schema mutations, RLS policies, and environment variable dependencies.

### Fresh-Context Skeptic Reviewer

A separate reviewer context with zero author bias audits the diff. Enforces calibrated epistemic confidence: verified by test, inferred by code, or assumed.

### Time-Travel Runtime Tracer

Inspect uncaught exceptions, assertion actual vs expected values, and intermediate variables in child processes without polluting source code with console.logs.

## The first agent and IDE that are actually one.

Other tools bolt a chat panel onto an editor, or wrap an agent in a terminal. Cerin was designed from the first line as a single system: the agent edits in your editor, runs in your terminal and remembers what you did by hand. You decide how much it does on its own.

### An autonomy dial, not an on/off switch.

Pick a mode to see how Cerin behaves.

Cerin reads the repo and proposes a step-by-step plan. Nothing is edited until you approve it.

### One context, everywhere

Editor, terminal, research and agent share up to 1M tokens — nothing is copied between tools.

### Any model, your keys

Anthropic to Together AI, hosted or bring-your-own. Swap per task without restarting the chat.

### Review, then ship

Every change is a diff with checkpoints. Accept by hunk, roll back in one click, open the PR.

### Native, not a webview tab

A real desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that opens large monorepos without stalling.

### Private by default

Tokens stay in your OS keychain. Cerin only sees the repositories you explicitly choose.
